claim_ceiling: At 19-year scale (122k decisions), linear combinations of center-projected dense embeddings (w=0.3) + TF-IDF citation signals PASS both adversarial gates (LangDom=0.626, JP=0.647), representing the first dense-hybrid to do so. However, TF-IDF citation-only baseline (JP=0.724) remains superior for jurist preference. Dense embeddings recover citation heritage at AUC 0.79-0.85 (21-22yr scale), exceeding TF-IDF citation-based (AUC 0.71-0.74), but fail jurist gate due to language dominance. Full 174k dense evaluation blocked by missing data (2022-2026) and ID mapping. No representation dominates all three metrics (LangDom, JP, CiteIndep) at any scale.
evidence_summary: 12 primary result files independently verified across producer workspace and control plane. All critical claims recomputed from raw evidence: (1) TF-IDF 174k suite PASS (LangDom=0.472, JP=0.724); (2) Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at ALL scales (3yr JP=0.39-0.42, 15yr JP=0.288, 19yr JP=0.3685, 20yr JP=0.0475 catastrophic, 22yr JP=0.3975); (3) Linear hybrids PASS at 19yr w=0.5 (JP=0.54) but below TF-IDF baseline; (4) Weight sweep reveals optimal w=0.3 (+0.102 JP over w=0.5, JP=0.647) but still below TF-IDF; (5) Citation heritage: dense AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF citation AUC 0.71-0.74 at 21-22yr (137k-144k decisions); (6) Section cross-lingual: sachverhalt superior (gap=0.187 vs 0.452); (7) Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at all scales; (8) v8 holdout: minimal leakage (LangDom +0.005, JP -0.015); (9) Boilerplate resistance invalid (all scores -0.84 to -0.94); (10) Fundamental blocker: 144k/174k decisions, missing 2022-2026 parquet and bge_/bger_ ID mapping. All negative/null results honestly represented with full numbers. No benchmark gaming, prettiness-as-quality, or unsupported claims detected.
